literal: He who lives the domestic life by its natural duty is called the foremost among all those who strive.
translation: He who lives the domestic life in accordance with its natural virtue is the foremost among all those who strive for spiritual liberation.
modern: அறநெறியின் இயல்போடு இல்லற வாழ்க்கை வாழ்பவன், நற்கதிக்காக முயலும் மற்ற எல்லோரையும் விட முதன்மையானவன் ஆவான்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the supreme value of a righteous householder. The word 'இயல்பு' refers to the natural, virtuous duties of a householder, which include supporting others and living selflessly. The poet compares this householder to 'முயல்வார்', those who perform intense spiritual penance or strive for liberation. By declaring the householder as 'தலை' (the foremost), the couplet teaches that fulfilling one's domestic duties virtuously is superior to escaping the world through asceticism.
